# gws recipe: Log a deal update

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the log-deal-update recipe: append a deal status update to a Google Sheets sales tracking spreadsheet — find the « Sales Pipeline » sheet with a Drive query, read the current data, append a new row (date, company, stage, amount, quarter, owner). A concrete business use case with a reusable pattern for any Sheets tracking — no equivalent in lots 31-33. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free); the `gws-sheets` and `gws-drive` prerequisites come from the same repo but are not listed in this catalog; install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
